requiredInvariants.rule: All user business writes are local-first and transactionally enqueue an outbox operation.
Dirty local records are never silently overwritten by cloud pulls.
Formal actual record outranks effective formal plan, which outranks local fallback suggestion.
Missing patch fields and empty arrays are no-op; deletion must be explicit.
Routine scene and role are explicit authoritative fields and are never inferred from title, type, id, or steps.
Timer sessions are immutable execution facts and formal training logs require user confirmation.
Daily compatible AI cannot mutate formal plans, adjustments, goals, strategies, or routines.
Advanced AI integrations may only submit pending coach_plan_patches; formal plan entities change only after Shenk validates and the user confirms the patch.

Phase 1 advanced-AI exchange uses only provider-neutral clipboard copy/paste. Later API, MCP, or Skill integrations may replace transport only and must preserve the same normalized snapshot, coach_plan_patch, validation, confirmation, and audit semantics.
Secrets and real health data never enter source, docs, URLs, logs, fixtures, Git, or normal backups.
Production Android uses Kotlin and Jetpack Compose; Capacitor remains a frozen prototype.

Production Android targets the current stable Android platform and current LTS JDK using an officially compatible stable toolchain; no legacy device or OS compatibility code is added without explicit approval.
Deleted items disappear from normal UI immediately; tombstones remain internal to synchronization.
